name: New range-high continuation (1h)
rationale: Price pinned at the ceiling of its 1h channel while ADX confirms a trend is the classic 'strength begets strength' setup: buyers who missed the initial move chase new highs and stops from earlier shorts cascade into the breakout. The other side is the mean-reversion trader shorting the high who is squeezed. Edge persists because new highs are a public, salient signal that draws late trend capital. Distinct from the momentum-return specs: the trigger is positional (where in the range) not a return threshold. Disconfirmer: exits when ADX falls under the exit floor or the time stop fires if the high stalls.
catalyst: price holding new range highs within a confirmed trend
